spanish: Y partieron desde Hor el monte, camino de mar de Suf, para rodear tierra de Edom, y se acortó el alma del pueblo en el camino.

findings.issue: סוּף is a common noun (H5488, absolute), not a proper name; “Suf” leaves that non-name lemma untranslated.
Qal 3fs “became short” is smoothed with pronominal “se”; the subject is still the soul and the stem force is unchanged.

notes: The rest of the clause matches the tokens in number, person, construct, and participants.
